name: 43201 · Columbus, OH
findings: ZIP 43201 (Columbus) has 161 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (51% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43201 (Columbus) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 43201 (Columbus) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
